Have you been aweary of gaudiness servers?Are you still queuing for the servers which are packed out all the time?Our Minecraft server may be the best choice for you.
●GAME MODE
It is a totally survival server.
All players in the server are equal and the server will take measures to protect players' property to ensure fairness.The server has also equipped with the strictest anti-cheat technology so that the order of server is absolutely guaranteed.
●VERSION NUMBER:1.21.8.
Genuine validation isn't required.
The server is completely free of charge.
●PLUGIN
We have incorporated a currency system into the game, which you can use to exchange items.
Welcome to our server! Happy playing!
